title: Operating Lines of Credit Collateral Note: Advance Rate on Prepaid Crop Inputs as the Term Runs
content:
Prepaid, unapplied crop inputs reported on an Operating Lines of Credit borrowing base certificate are lent against at a rate that falls as the term runs on, measured by how many whole months after the start of the current term the certificate's as-of date falls.

## Rule

Prepaid inputs are lent against at:

- **zero** when the certificate's as-of date falls 6 or more whole months after the start of the current term;
- **0.5 times the product's advance rate on prepaid inputs** when it falls at least 3 but fewer than 6 whole months after it;
- **the product's advance rate on prepaid inputs** when it falls fewer than 3 whole months after it.

The start of the current term is the last renewal date, or the booking date for a line never renewed. A whole month is counted only once the as-of date reaches the same day of the month as the term start.

## Rates by product (percent of invoiced cost)

| Product | Product rate on prepaid inputs | Fewer than 3 whole months | 3 to fewer than 6 whole months | 6 or more whole months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 70 | 70 | 35 | 0 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 70 | 70 | 35 | 0 |
| StartRight Operating Line, ExpressLine Operating Credit, Seasonal Operating Loan, Revolving Operating Line | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Counting whole months (hypothetical line, current term started 15 March)

| Certificate as-of date | Whole months after the term start | Rate on prepaid inputs (Borrowing Base Operating Line) |
|---|---|---|
| 14 June | 2 — 15 June not yet reached | 70% |
| 15 June | 3 | 35% |
| 14 September | 5 | 35% |
| 15 September | 6 | 0% |

## Question on the rule

**Which date starts the count on a line that has been renewed?** The last renewal date. Only a line that has never been renewed counts from its booking date.
